name: – Tomáš Kubín – Article 12, after § 3 – Am 94
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive on the structure and rates of excise duty applied to tobacco and tobacco related products (recast)
part_text: 3a. The newly adjusted minimum tax level shall not be lower than the minimum excise duty applicable in the Member State immediately prior to the rate adjustment pursuant to paragraphs 2 and 3. Where the adjustment would result in a lower level, the minimum excise duty shall remain unchanged at its pre-adjustment level.
